defect: per-decision node budget was cumulative and depended on the CALLER incrementing stats["decisions"]
impact: offline harnesses incremented it, so the budget was never binding there; the packaged main.py did not, so a submitted match shared one 40-node budget and the agent searched 3 of 84 decisions before degrading to pure baseline
severity: S8.2.6 - the uploaded agent was not the evaluated agent
fix: local per-decision node counter in c018_search.plan

harness_equivalence.conclusion: search intensity per decision is unchanged, so M01/M02/M03 evidence generated before the fix remains valid and was not regenerated
